name: Quipu
description: Quipu — Spanish invoicing and bookkeeping for autónomos and small companies: issued and received invoices, contacts, book entries and accounting categories. REST API, OAuth 2.0 client credentials.
instructions:
**Getting credentials**
1. In Quipu, create the API credentials for your account (see the API reference at quipuapp.github.io/api-v1-docs).
2. You receive a **client id** and **client secret**. Quipu's API uses the client-credentials grant, so there is no browser consent step for your own account's data. The token request is sent with HTTP Basic credentials and the fixed scope `ecommerce`, which Quipu requires on every token request (without it: `400 invalid_scope`); the adapter sends both. Tokens last 2 hours.
3. Set `QUIPU_CLIENT_ID` and `QUIPU_CLIENT_SECRET`. AnythingMCP fetches and refreshes the access token on its own.

**JSON:API, not plain JSON.** Quipu follows the JSON:API specification: rows arrive as `{"data": [{"id": …, "type": "invoices", "attributes": {…}, "relationships": {…}}]}`. The interesting fields are inside `attributes`, and relationships are ids that need an `include` to resolve. This is why `include` appears on the tools below.

**The Accept header is `application/vnd.quipu.v1+json`**, Quipu's versioned media type, required on every call; with the generic JSON:API type `application/vnd.api+json` every path answers 404. The adapter sends it.

**Issued vs received.** Quipu keeps both in `/invoices`, told apart by `filter[kind]`: `quipu_list_invoices` asks for `income` (what you issue), `quipu_list_expenses` for `expenses` (supplier invoices you record). Tickets, paysheets and additional incomes are separate book entries; `quipu_list_book_entries` lists everything together. Dates are filtered by `period` (`2026Q1`, `2026-09`), not by a from/to range. Invoices and expenses both carry the Spanish tax fields — IVA and IRPF retention — separately from the totals.

**Paging** is `page[number]` and `page[size]` (max 100, default 25), with `total_pages`, `current_page` and `total_results` in the response's `meta.pagination_info`. The API allows 5 requests per 5 seconds.

**Checked against the published spec, not yet a live tenant.** Paths, headers and filter names follow Quipu's OpenAPI document, and every route used here answers 401 (exists) without a token. The reference writes paths with an account prefix (`/{owner_slug}/contacts`); the adapter uses the unprefixed form, which Quipu also routes. If a live token gets 404 where the docs say the resource exists, the account prefix is the first thing to try.

**Cloud reachability**: getquipu.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: quipu_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts — customers and suppliers — with their name, NIF, address and the country they invoice from.

q.description: Free-text search across contact fields (name, NIF, e-mail…).

tools.name: quipu_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact by id, with their full tax data, address and the default payment terms recorded against them.

tools.name: quipu_list_invoices
tools.description: List issued invoices with their number, date, contact, IVA and IRPF amounts, total and payment state — the revenue side.

period.description: Period to filter by: a quarter like 2026Q1 or a month like 2026-09.

payment_status.description: Payment state. `unpaid` covers both pending and overdue.

contact_id.description: Only entries of this contact id.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, comma-separated. Allowed: items, contact, accounting_category, accounting_subcategory, items.accounting_category, items.accounting_subcategory.

tools.name: quipu_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one issued invoice in full: every line with its quantity, price, IVA rate and IRPF retention, plus the totals and the payments applied.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, comma-separated. Allowed: items, contact, accounting_category, accounting_subcategory, items.accounting_category, items.accounting_subcategory.

tools.name: quipu_list_expenses
tools.description: List received supplier invoices (Quipu's invoices of kind `expenses`) with their date, supplier, category, IVA and total — the cost side of the ledger. Tickets and paysheets are in quipu_list_book_entries.

period.description: Period to filter by: a quarter like 2026Q1 or a month like 2026-09.

payment_status.description: Payment state. `unpaid` covers both pending and overdue.

contact_id.description: Only entries of this contact id.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, comma-separated. Allowed: items, contact, accounting_category, accounting_subcategory, items.accounting_category, items.accounting_subcategory.

tools.name: quipu_list_book_entries
tools.description: List all book entries in one place — invoices, tickets (simplified receipts), paysheets and additional incomes — with number, date, counterpart and totals. Use it when a question spans more than full invoices, e.g. every cost of a quarter.

period.description: Period to filter by: a quarter like 2026Q1 or a month like 2026-09.

payment_status.description: Payment state. `unpaid` covers both pending and overdue.

contact_id.description: Only entries of this contact id.

include.description: Relationships to resolve inline, comma-separated. Allowed: items, contact, accounting_category, accounting_subcategory, items.accounting_category, items.accounting_subcategory.

tools.name: quipu_list_accounting_categories
tools.description: List the accounting categories expenses are filed under, so a cost breakdown uses the categories the bookkeeper actually uses.

kind.description: Comma-separated kinds: expenses, income, assets, capital, creditor_debitor, financial.
